confidence_notes: The FX observation comes from an RBA search result: 0.6720 USD per AUD on 2026-11-18. Restaurant meal, beer and coffee anchors are based on crowd-sourced cost-of-living indexes for Wollongong (MyLifeElsewhere, Travel Tables, some dated 2023 and inconsistent with each other), so they are rough. I found no verified Wollongong menu prices for cocktails or wine. Those two are set from the local beer price relationship and general Australian regional pricing (cocktail about 2.2x beer, wine glass about 1.45x beer). The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, with no listings or booking pages checked. They are the least certain, because Wollongong rates vary a lot by season and weekend.
comparable_city_reasoning: Wollongong is a coastal regional city south of Sydney. Its prices are roughly on par with or slightly below Sydney for food and drink, and its accommodation is cheaper than Sydney's but not far below other NSW coastal destinations.
